## DG101

**Private key committed** (critical, added lines)

A PEM private key block was added to the repository.

**Fix:** Remove the key, rotate it, and load it from a secret manager.

Flagged:

```
deploy/key.pem: ----**** RSA PRIVATE KEY-****
```

Not flagged:

```
deploy/key.pub: ----**** PUBLIC KEY-****
```

## DG102

**Cloud or SaaS API key** (critical, added lines)

A credential in a well-known provider format was added: AWS access key, GitHub token, Stripe live key, Slack token or Google API key.

**Fix:** Revoke the credential now, then read it from the environment.

Flagged:

```
src/aws.py: KEY = "AKIA****"
ci/env.sh: export GH_T****
pay.js: const stripe = Stripe('sk_l****')
```

Not flagged:

```
docs/aws.md: aws_**** = AKIA****
pay.js: const stripe = Stripe(proc****)
```

## DG103

**Hardcoded credential** (high, added lines)

A password, secret, API key or token is assigned a literal value.

**Fix:** Read the value from the environment or a secret manager.

Flagged:

```
src/client.py: API_KEY = "sk-l****"
config/prod.yml: db_p****: "Tr0u****"
src/mail.js: const smtp**** = 'hunt****'
```

Not flagged:

```
src/client.py: API_KEY = os.e****["API_KEY"]
config/prod.yml: db_p****: "${DB_P****}"
src/forms.py: pass**** = "Pass****"
src/client.py: API_KEY = "YOUR****"
```

## DG104

**Credentials embedded in URL** (high, added lines)

A connection string or URL contains a username and password.

**Fix:** Pass credentials separately, read from the environment.

Flagged:

```
src/db.py: URL = "post****://admin:S3cr****:5432****"
```

Not flagged:

```
src/db.py: URL = "post****://user:pass****"
src/db.py: URL = f"post****://{user}:{pw}@{host}/app"
```

## DG201

**SQL built from string formatting** (critical, added lines)

A SQL statement is built with f-strings, %, +, .format() or template literals and passed to a query API. This is the classic SQL injection shape.

**Fix:** Use parameterized queries (placeholders plus a separate params argument).

Flagged:

```
app/db.py: cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id={uid}")
app/db.py: cursor.execute("DELETE FROM t WHERE id=%s" % uid)
api/users.js: db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${req.params.id}`)
repo/u.go: rows, _ := db.Query(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM u WHERE id=%s", id))
Dao.java: stmt.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM u WHERE name='" + name + "'")
```

Not flagged:

```
app/db.py: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s", (uid,))
api/users.js: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [id])
app/log.py: logger.info(f"select a value from {x}")
```

## DG202

**Dynamic code execution** (critical, added lines)

eval/exec/new Function is called on a non-literal value.

**Fix:** Parse the input (json, ast.literal_eval) instead of executing it.

Flagged:

```
calc.py: return eval(request.args['expr'])
run.py: exec(code)
a.js: const fn = new Function('a', body)
a.js: eval(userInput)
```

Not flagged:

```
calc.py: result = ast.literal_eval(text)
a.js: const m = re.exec(str)
train.py: model.eval()
boot.py: exec('import os')
```

## DG203

**Shell command built from input** (high, added lines)

A shell command is run with shell=True or built by string concatenation.

**Fix:** Pass an argument list and avoid the shell (shell=False, execFile, exec.Command args).

Flagged:

```
deploy.py: subprocess.run(f'tar xf {name}', shell=True)
deploy.py: os.system('rm -rf ' + path)
a.js: exec(`git clone ${url}`)
a.go: cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", userCmd)
```

Not flagged:

```
deploy.py: subprocess.run(['tar', 'xf', name], check=True)
deploy.py: os.system('clear')
a.go: cmd := exec.Command("git", "clone", url)
```

## DG204

**Unsafe deserialization** (high, added lines)

Data is deserialized with a format that can execute code (pickle, yaml.load, ObjectInputStream, unserialize).

**Fix:** Use a data-only format (JSON) or a safe loader (yaml.safe_load).

Flagged:

```
loader.py: data = pickle.loads(request.body)
conf.py: cfg = yaml.load(stream)
Svc.java: ObjectInputStream in = new ObjectInputStream(sock.getInputStream());
```

Not flagged:

```
conf.py: cfg = yaml.safe_load(stream)
conf.py: cfg = yaml.load(stream, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader)
loader.py: data = json.loads(body)
```

## DG205

**Unescaped HTML output (XSS sink)** (medium, added lines)

Content is written to the page without escaping.

**Fix:** Render text (textContent, auto-escaped templates) or sanitize with a vetted library.

Flagged:

```
ui/App.tsx: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: comment}} />
ui/app.js: el.innerHTML = msg
templates/p.html: {{ comment|safe }}
views.py: return mark_safe(user_bio)
```

Not flagged:

```
ui/app.js: el.textContent = msg
ui/app.js: if (el.innerHTML === '') {
templates/p.html: {{ comment }}
```

## DG301

**TLS certificate verification disabled** (high, added lines)

Certificate or hostname verification is turned off, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.

**Fix:** Keep verification on; point to a custom CA bundle if you need one.

Flagged:

```
http.py: r = requests.get(url, verify=False)
client.ts: const agent = new https.Agent({ rejectUnauthorized: false })
tls.go: cfg := &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true}
Dockerfile: RUN curl -k https://example.com/install.sh | sh
```

Not flagged:

```
http.py: r = requests.get(url, verify=True)
http.py: r = requests.get(url, verify=ca_bundle)
Dockerfile: RUN curl -fsSL https://example.com/x.sh -o x.sh
```

## DG302

**Weak hash for passwords** (high, added lines)

MD5 or SHA-1 is applied to a password or secret.

**Fix:** Hash passwords with bcrypt, scrypt or argon2.

Flagged:

```
users.py: user.pw_hash = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
```

Not flagged:

```
cache.py: key = hashlib.md5(url.encode()).hexdigest()
```

## DG303

**Weak hash algorithm** (low, added lines)

MD5 or SHA-1 is used. Fine for checksums, broken for anything security-related.

**Fix:** Use SHA-256 or better; pass usedforsecurity=False for non-security checksums.

Flagged:

```
a.js: crypto.createHash('sha1').update(body)
```

Not flagged:

```
a.py: digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
a.py: etag = hashlib.md5(body, usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest()
```

## DG304

**Weak cipher or mode** (medium, added lines)

A broken cipher (DES, 3DES, RC4, Blowfish) or ECB mode is used.

**Fix:** Use AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 from a high-level library.

Flagged:

```
c.py: cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_ECB)
c.js: crypto.createCipheriv('des-ede3-cbc', key, iv)
C.java: Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding");
```

Not flagged:

```
c.py: cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_GCM, nonce=nonce)
C.java: Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
```

## DG305

**Insecure randomness for a secret** (medium, added lines)

A non-cryptographic random generator produces a token, password or nonce.

**Fix:** Use secrets (Python), crypto.randomBytes / crypto.randomUUID (Node) or SecureRandom.

Flagged:

```
t.py: token = ''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(32))
t.js: const resetToken = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
```

Not flagged:

```
t.py: token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
t.py: delay = random.uniform(0.1, 0.5)
```

## DG306

**JWT verification disabled** (high, added lines)

A JWT is accepted without checking its signature, algorithm or expiry.

**Fix:** Verify with an explicit algorithm allow-list and keep expiry checks on.

Flagged:

```
auth.py: claims = jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})
auth.js: jwt.verify(token, key, { algorithms: ['none'] })
```

Not flagged:

```
auth.py: claims = jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=["HS256"])
```

## DG401

**Authentication bypass added** (high, added lines)

An endpoint or the whole app is opened to unauthenticated users.

**Fix:** Scope public access to specific routes and keep authentication on by default.

Flagged:

```
views.py: permission_classes = [AllowAny]
Sec.java: http.authorizeRequests().anyRequest().permitAll();
settings.py: SKIP_AUTH = True
.env: AUTH_DISABLED=true
```

Not flagged:

```
views.py: permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
Sec.java: .requestMatchers("/health").permitAll()
.env: AUTH_ENABLED=true
```

## DG402

**CSRF protection disabled** (high, added lines)

Cross-site request forgery protection is turned off for a view or the app.

**Fix:** Keep CSRF on; for token-authenticated APIs, scope the exemption narrowly.

Flagged:

```
views.py: @csrf_exempt
Sec.java: http.csrf().disable();
app.py: app.config['WTF_CSRF_ENABLED'] = False
```

Not flagged:

```
views.py: @csrf_protect
```

## DG403

**Privilege grant added** (medium, added lines)

Code grants admin/superuser rights or assigns a privileged role.

**Fix:** Confirm the grant is intended, authorized and audited.

Flagged:

```
users.py: grant_admin(user)
users.py: user.is_superuser = True
seed.js: await User.create({ email, role: 'admin' })
```

Not flagged:

```
users.py: user.is_superuser = False
users.py: if user.role == 'admin':
```

## DG501

**Debug mode enabled** (medium, added lines)

Debug mode is switched on in a non-development file; it leaks stack traces and secrets.

**Fix:** Drive debug from the environment and default it to off.

Flagged:

```
settings.py: DEBUG = True
app.py: app.run(host='0.0.0.0', debug=True)
.env.production: APP_DEBUG=true
```

Not flagged:

```
settings.py: DEBUG = env.bool('DEBUG', default=False)
settings/dev.py: DEBUG = True
```

## DG502

**CORS allows any origin** (medium, added lines)

Cross-origin requests are allowed from any origin.

**Fix:** List the origins that need access.

Flagged:

```
main.py: app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"])
server.js: app.use(cors({ origin: '*' }))
settings.py: CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS = True
```

Not flagged:

```
main.py: app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["https://app.example.com"])
```

## DG503

**World-writable permissions** (medium, added lines)

Files are made writable by every user.

**Fix:** Grant the narrowest permissions needed (e.g. 755 / 644).

Flagged:

```
Dockerfile: RUN chmod -R 777 /app
setup.py: os.chmod(path, 0o777)
```

Not flagged:

```
Dockerfile: RUN chmod 755 /app/entrypoint.sh
```

## DG601

**Authentication or authorization check removed** (high, removed lines)

A line enforcing login, permissions or roles was deleted and not re-added elsewhere in the change.

**Fix:** Confirm the endpoint is still protected (decorator, middleware or explicit check).

Flagged:

```
views.py: if not current_user.is_authenticated:
views.py:     abort(401)
views.py: @login_required
api.py: def read(user = Depends(get_current_user)):
Ctl.java: @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")
```

Not flagged:

```
views.py: logger.info('rendering page')
```

## DG602

**CSRF protection removed** (high, removed lines)

CSRF middleware, tokens or checks were deleted.

**Fix:** Restore CSRF protection or document why the endpoint does not need it.

Flagged:

```
app.js: app.use(csrfProtection)
settings.py:     'django.middleware.csrf.CsrfViewMiddleware',
```

Not flagged:

```
views.py: @csrf_exempt
```

## DG603

**Password hashing removed** (high, removed lines)

A password hashing or verification call was deleted.

**Fix:** Make sure passwords are still hashed with a slow KDF before storage.

Flagged:

```
users.py: user.pw = bcrypt.hash(raw)
users.py: user.set_password(raw)
```

Not flagged:

```
users.py: user.name = name
```

## DG604

**Input validation removed** (medium, removed lines)

A validation, sanitization or escaping step was deleted.

**Fix:** Confirm the input is still validated before use.

Flagged:

```
forms.py: if not validate(token):
api.py: data = sanitize(payload)
```

Not flagged:

```
api.py: data = payload
```

## DG605

**Security hardening removed** (medium, removed lines)

Rate limiting, security headers or secure cookie settings were deleted.

**Fix:** Confirm the protection is provided elsewhere (proxy, middleware, framework default).

Flagged:

```
app.js: app.use(helmet())
settings.py: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True
api.py: @limiter.limit('5/minute')
```

Not flagged:

```
app.js: app.use(express.json())
```
